overview: Memo (1947) debates pricing looted tin recovered in Japan at the low Malayan buying rate versus higher US selling rate.

people.name: Virginia D. Karchere
people.role: Department of State participant and author of the memorandum

subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on the Price of Looted Tin Found in Japan
subfiles.from: Virginia D. Karchere, Department of State
subfiles.about: Records Marion Worthing’s reservations about using the U.S. buying price in Malaya to value tin looted from Malaya and the Netherlands East Indies and later recovered in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Worthing argues the US should charge its higher selling price, not the lower Malayan rate, for tin recovered in Japan.

interest: Index on pricing disputes over looted tin recovered in Japan.
